name: My Clips' progress in Plugin Pages' host, as admin in the Auto host mode (PageHostMode=Auto at startup, with Plugin Pages installed; VideoPreset slow, so its three long Accurate clips take a while): My Clips opens in Plugin Pages' host and polls the clips being made; Back to the home page leaves the page in jellyfin-web's cached, hidden host view, where nothing of ours is asked (no Status, list or Summary request; before the review it went on polling every 2.5 s); Forward shows the view again, the kit renders the page again and it polls again while a clip is still being made. It seeds and deletes its own bookmarks (named 'clips-pp-probe …'; a failed run's leftovers at the start). Needs a sandbox started in Auto mode (Set-SandboxPluginConfig PageHostMode=Auto and VideoPreset=slow, then a restart; scripts/README.md says how).

steps.name: the requests of the Bookmarks script recorded in every document (jellyfin-web's own never)
open the login page
index.html carries Plugin Pages' tag (its startup task registers the File Transformation a few seconds after the server starts; the kit chooses the host once per page load)
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => t.indexOf('<script plugin="PluginPages"') >= 0)

steps.name: reload, so the page has the tag
sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
the kit chose the Plugin Pages host for My Clips
its link
a failed run's leftovers deleted, then three long ranges of Long Test Movie with Accurate clips asked for (one is made at a time, so the others wait)
steps.script: const PREFIX = 'clips-pp-probe'; const json = (type, path, body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type, url: ApiClient.getUrl(path), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); let leftovers = 0; for (let round = 0; round < 5; round++) { const q = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: PREFIX, limit: 200 })); const ids = q.Items.filter(b => (b.Name || '').indexOf(PREFIX) === 0).map(b => b.Id); if (ids.length === 0) break; await json('POST', 'Bookmarks/BulkDelete', { Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }); leftovers += ids.length; } const kept = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Clips', { searchTerm: PREFIX, limit: 200 })); for (const c of kept.Items.filter(x => (x.Name || '').indexOf(PREFIX) === 0)) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + c.Id + '/Clip') }); leftovers++; } const items = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Items', { userId: ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), Recursive: true, IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Fields: 'Path', EnableImages: false, EnableUserData: false })); const movie = items.Items.find(i => (i.Path || '').indexOf('Long Test Movie (2021)') >= 0); const T = 10000000; const ids = []; const asked = []; for (const [name, start] of [['Golf', 0], ['Hotel', 2], ['India', 4]]) { const b = await json('POST', 'Bookmarks', { ItemId: movie.Id, StartTicks: start * T, EndTicks: (start + 175) * T, Name: PREFIX + ' ' + name }); ids.push(b.Id); const c = await json('POST', 'Bookmarks/' + b.Id + '/Clip', { Mode: 'Accurate' }); asked.push(c.Clip.Status); } return { leftovers, movie: movie.Id, ids, asked };

steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfbm-page=clips][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state=on]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; const rows = [...c.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-clips-row')]; if (rows.length < 3) return false; return { host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), rows: rows.length, making: rows.filter(x => x.getAttribute('data-jfbm-state') === 'InProgress').length, renders: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.state().renders.clips }; })()

steps.script: const PREFIX = 'clips-pp-probe'; await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: __vars.seed.ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const q = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: PREFIX, limit: 10 })); const c = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Clips', { searchTerm: PREFIX, limit: 10 })); return { bookmarks: q.TotalRecordCount, clips: c.TotalRecordCount };
